# Saved by the Plate

> Saved by the Plate is a nonprofit organization empowering communities to make
> informed food choices by connecting them to local food resources and providing
> youth education in food justice, sustainable agriculture, and urban gardening.
> Based in New York City, serving schools and communities across the five boroughs.

## About

Saved by the Plate Inc. was founded by Shay Bouchles to bridge the gap between
communities and local food systems. We provide experiential programs, an
AI-powered garden planning assistant, and an interactive map of food resources
including community gardens, farmers markets, food banks, and community fridges.

Our mission: Empower the next generation to build a resilient food future by
connecting children and families to community gardens, sustainable eating
education, and food justice initiatives across New York City and beyond.

## Programs

- Community Gardens & Food Justice: 6-week customizable youth program covering
  the history of urban gardens in NYC, community growing strategies, urban
  biodiversity, and environmental justice
- Composting, Soil Science & Sustainability: 6-week youth program covering food
  waste reduction, composting fundamentals, soil nutrients, and soil ecosystems
- Programs are fully customizable: single session, 6-week series, or 12-week semester
- Optional community garden tour included with every program
- Guest speaker included in every program

## Tools & Features

- Ask Jane (AI Garden Planner): AI-powered gardening assistant providing
  personalized gardening advice and custom growing plans
- Local Food Map: Interactive map of community gardens, farmers markets, food
  banks, community fridges, urban farms, and CSAs across New York City
